cases.name: Tolt Hill 1969 Jane Doe
cases.about: She was described as white, 23 to 25 years old, 5-foot-1 to 5-foot-2, 105-115 pounds, with dark hair. She had been dead for up to six months.
cases.narrative: On 6/5/1969, her body was found one mile west of the Tolt River Bridge near Carnation on what is now 290th Avenue Northeast.

cases.name: Tolt Hill Female 2006
cases.about: Please send information about her life, dreams or interests to shecounted@gmail.com
cases.narrative: On 11/25/2006, the op portion of her skull was found in a horse pasture. The remains are very old and may be a related victim to the “Tolt Hill 1969 Jane Doe” homicide whose unidentified body was recovered three blocks away in 1969.
